description: This file defines a React context provider and hooks for managing authentication state in a gym management system frontend. It handles session initialization, auth state changes, sign-in via email and Google OAuth, and exposes authentication data and methods to components within the React app.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React functional component that provides authentication context, manages session state, and handles sign-in/sign-out operations.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook to access authentication context, throws error if used outside AuthProvider.

methods.name: useRole
methods.description: Custom hook to retrieve the current user's role from metadata.

methods.name: useSupabaseAuth
methods.description: Alias hook for useAuth, maintained for backward compatibility.
